identity.title: Zero net flux does not imply zero tilt energy or anisotropic stress (antipodal two-stream)

theorem.fixture: two equal-weight streams with velocities +e_x and -e_x (unit weight each).
claims: second moment K = diag(2,0,0), trace(K) = 2 > 0 (nonzero tilt energy)
anisotropic stress 3*Pi = 3K - trace(K)*I = diag(4,-2,-2): traceless (4-2-2=0) but nonzero (4 != 0)
the same-trace isotropic comparator diag(2/3,2/3,2/3) has zero anisotropic stress; F=0 distinguishes neither, Pi does

notes: Wolfram/SymPy/Sage do exact rational matrix algebra; Lean and Rocq (independent kernels) verify the integer identities F=0, trace=2>0, 3Pi=diag(4,-2,-2) traceless-and-nonzero. No majority vote; all five axes PASS.
